about: The handicapper's books, one per track (the test driver's lap times in seconds: standing, from rest to the end of the first lap; flying, a lap at speed). Timed by tools/ref/handicaps.ts <id> [track].

millbrook.about: Millbrook Outer Circuit handicapper's book (reviews 86, 89): the test driver's lap times in seconds, from rest to the end of the first lap (standing) and a lap at speed (flying), from tools/ref/handicaps.ts, with the review-89 tyres; retimed in review 97 (the free wheels no longer drag); retimed in review 120 (the car in 3D: its axles, the tyres' relaxation, crests felt). Retimed in review 152 (the driver looks far enough ahead to brake from its own speed, and does not floor a powerful car near the grip in a bend). The NSX (review 153) timed on the resurfaced track: on the period concrete its tail swings out after landing from the Members' Bridge bump. The F355 and F355 F1 (review 158) timed on the resurfaced track, like the NSX.
